headline: Master Peyton Hits 174 Again as the EFL’s Perfect Trio Reaches 3-0
dek: Master Peyton posted the week’s high score for a second straight week, Blaze Infantry survived The Duke by 1.74, and The Don’s Soldiers joined them at 3-0 as Week 3 scoring rebounded to 115.80 per team.

lead.title: Master Peyton Sets the Pace Again
lead.body: Master Peyton beat KamaraVirus125177 174.50–86.34 to move to 3-0 and post the EFL’s top score for the second consecutive week after scoring 175.24 in Week 2. At 509.90 points through three weeks, Master Peyton leads the league in scoring by 59.58 over The Don’s Soldiers at 450.32. The Don’s Soldiers and Blaze Infantry also remain 3-0; Blaze survived The Duke 127.46–125.72 in the week’s closest game.

briefs.label: PHOTO FINISH
briefs.title: Blaze Survives by 1.74
briefs.body: Blaze Infantry edged The Duke 127.46–125.72, the tightest Week 3 result. The win kept Blaze unbeaten at 3-0 and dropped The Duke to 1-2.

briefs.label: POWER BOARD
briefs.title: Trash Pandas Jump Two
briefs.body: The current EFL power recalculation keeps Master Peyton, The Don’s Soldiers and Kaaron Rodgers at Nos. 1-3. Trash Pandas rises two spots from No. 6 to No. 4 at 76.4, Mach Chicken moves from No. 7 to No. 6, while Blaze Infantry slides from No. 5 to No. 7 despite its 3-0 start.

briefs.label: SCORING DESK
briefs.title: League Offense Ticks Back Up
briefs.body: Week 3 averaged 115.80 points per franchise, up 3.45 from Week 2’s 112.35 but still below Week 1’s 119.68. Kaaron Rodgers scored 163.26 and The Don’s Soldiers 147.08 behind Master Peyton’s 174.50, while LandsharkSC’s 78.76 was the week’s low.

briefs.label: TRANSACTION WIRE
briefs.title: $18 Kendre Miller Claim Leads the Wire
briefs.body: Master Peyton posted the largest verified Week 3 waiver bid, $18 for Kendre Miller. The Don’s Soldiers spent $13 on Darren Waller, The Duke spent $8 on Konata Mumpfield, and Blaze Infantry added Trey Benson and Kalif Raymond as free agents. Sleeper showed no completed trade in the Week 3 or early Week 4 transaction buckets as of September 29.
